items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Millinder oh, where Lucky Miller was from in Alabama

ctx.x: Now, here we are -- stuck with no money, and we're playing the dance this night and hoping that we'll have a full house so we can pay the man for the bus. All right? Well, fortunately for us, we made the money to pay for the bus.
Now, we leave Athens, going in to Alabama into -- Millinder oh, where Lucky Miller was from in Alabama -- oh, where was that?
